participant_1.name: Emily
participant_1.personality: Fun-loving and adventurous, Emily is eager to explore life outside her parents' home. She values her friendships and enjoys spending time with people, while maintaining a responsible attitude towards her health.
participant_1.background: I am 19 and I cannot wait to move out of my parents' home. I just want to have fun with my friends. I do not drink or do drugs or anything. I work; I have a part-time job at Burger King.

participant_2.name: Mohamed
participant_2.personality: Reflective and serious, Mohamed carries a weight of past experiences that shape his views on life. He seeks freedom and is cautious about the responsibilities that come with adulthood.
participant_2.background: I was born in Somalia. Now I live in the United States. My aunt helped me escape when I was a child. I was forced to marry when I was a teenager.
